job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Design and build batch & streaming ETL/ELT pipelines from scratch
Develop and optimize RAG pipelines for AI applications
Implement document ingestion frameworks for PDF, DOCX, and unstructured data
Build and manage vector search systems (OpenSearch / Pinecone)
Create and expose data APIs for AI/ML applications
Own end-to-end pipeline lifecycle (design development deployment monitoring)
Architect and implement scalable data solutions using AWS services
Collaborate with AI/ML teams to support LLM-based use cases
Ensure data quality, performance, and observability using monitoring tools

Required Skills & Experience

57+ years of hands-on Data Engineering experience at scale
Strong expertise in Python (advanced), SQL, Spark / Spark SQL, ETL/ELT pipeline development (batch & streaming)
Deep understanding of: RAG architecture and workflows, Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search
Hands-on experience with AWS services: S3, Lambda, Athena, Step Functions, API Gateway, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, AWS Glue, Bedrock (preferred)
Experience working with unstructured data transformation (PDF, DOCX)
Strong knowledge of Docker (containerization)
Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Git/Bitbucket)
